latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of llm-router, a unified API gateway to 70+ AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Deepseek, Grok, and more) powered by AIsa.
- OpenAI-compatible chat completions and streaming with support for model switching, fallback, cost optimization, and unified billing.
- Built-in support for multi-model chat, vision/image analysis, and model comparison.
- Function calling and Gemini-native endpoint support.
- Python CLI and SDK client included for streamlined integration and usage.
- Requires only one API key (AISA_API_KEY) to access all supported models.
